The interface / 02

A sampler that
feels like hardware.

Six connected workspaces built around a fast visual workflow. Build and play on Scene, arrange on Project, mix on Mixer, perform from Controller, add hands-on scratch effects on Wax, then bring your sound to life in Visualizer.

01SCENE

Play your pads, build patterns and capture performances in your scenes.

02PROJECT

Arrange scenes and pads across the timeline with BPM, bars, grid and snap control.

03MIXER

Shape every scene with volume, pan, mute, solo and channel FX.

04CONTROLLER

Perform the final feed with pads, macro controls and real-time FX.

05WAX

Add hands-on vinyl scratch effects after the Controller in the audio chain.

06VISUALIZER

Bring your sound to life with immersive audio-reactive visuals. Explore presets, cycle through visual styles and fine-tune the look with dedicated tweaks and settings.

Chop system / 03

Seven ways to
find your flip.

Choose a chopping style to approach your sample from a different musical angle. Every style is designed around the 15-pad workflow.

01Chop TransientsFinds prominent attacks and transient moments.
02Kicks and SnaresFocuses on drum hits and rhythmic accents.
03The Golden RatioCombines core rhythmic sections with expressive tails and complementary chops.
04Ghost ChopExplores quieter details and subtle moments in the sample.
05Phrase LadderBuilds a sequence from musical phrases and phrase fragments.
06Harmonic StaircaseOrganises chops around tonal and harmonic movement.
07Flip GridCreates grid-based chops for rhythmic rearrangement.

STEM SEPARATOR / AUDIO EXTRACTION
ISOLATE THE ELEMENTS.

Take control
of every layer.

Pull a track apart into individual stems. Isolate drums, bass, vocals or instruments, then bring the parts into your scenes to build a new arrangement around the sounds you want.

01DRUMS
02BASS
03VOCALS
04INSTRUMENTS

Separate selected stems into your scenes, or bake them together into one scene.

Make it yours / 05

Same machine.
Different skin.

Customise the look of the workstation without changing the workflow. Settings currently offers six UI skins, six idle animations, six sample waveform styles and six waveform backgrounds.

06

UI SKINS

Choose from the six interface skins currently available in Settings to give the sampler its own visual character.

06

IDLE ANIMATIONS

Select one of six idle animations to bring the visualizer display to life when it is not actively responding to audio.

06

SAMPLE WAVEFORMS

Pick from six sample waveform styles to change how your audio is drawn across the sampler.

06

BACKGROUNDS

Choose from six waveform backgrounds to change the atmosphere behind the visual display.
